At this Texas crossroads, one driver pointed to his pump screen with a groan: $944 for a tank that cost $500 a year ago. The truckers Rachel Wolfe met at the Flying J are using every trick to survive: cooking meals in their cabs, waiting for rainstorms to wash their rigs and sleeping at loading docks to avoid overnight fees. With midterms just a month away, the crisis at the pump is fast becoming a political flashpoint.

At Mejuri, boardroom decisions were soon tied to government inflation data, policy moves in Washington and even reports of armed gangs turning to gold mining. As prices catapulted higher, the company leaned in to 10-karat gold, vermeil plating, silver and even ( gasp ) stainless steel, reports David Uberti.

4. READ IT HERE FIRST

 

Truckers are using every trick they can to survive soaring diesel prices.

 

Across the 12 fuel lanes at the Flying J Travel Center off Interstate 10—where rigs carrying soft drinks, steel, Mexican produce and Mississippi-bound car parts rumble to a stop—the economics of trucking have broken down. With midterms just a month away, the crisis at the pump is fast becoming a political flashpoint.
